text:
sasha: FYI escalated ticket from Acme — user can't open project console (403) right after their IdP rolled sessions. Customer is blocked.
acme-admin: Getting a 403 when I click into Projects > Alpha. Other teammates are fine. I logged in via Okta SSO ~30m ago. No password change.
lydia: sorry about that — can you paste the account email you used and the org id? also are you using a corp-managed device or private laptop?
acme-admin: email: jamie@acme.com, org: acme-alpha (org_id: org_789). Corp laptop. tried incognito => same 403.
sasha: quick check in our logs shows an authz failure:
```
[2026-03-17T14:02:04Z] authz: deny user=jamie@acme.com org=org_789 resource=project:alpha reason="no role bindings"
[2026-03-17T14:02:04Z] authn: okta_session_index=IDX:abcd1234 rotated_at=2026-03-17T13:35:00Z
```
lydia: can you grab the browser network trace when you click the project link and send the id token / x-redwood-sso headers (feel free to redact token body)?
acme-admin: attached header `x-redwood-sso-session: IDX:abcd1234` and `authorization: Bearer <redacted>`.
raj: thanks. this looks like the sessionIndex changed during IdP rotation. we had a recent Okta push that reissued sessionIndex values; our SCIM sync logic has a bug where if a user appears in SCIM with empty group list during the delta window we strip all group assignments in our local auth store. that can temporarily orphan users -> 403.
mia: confirmed — Okta rotated sessions at ~13:35 and the SCIM delta job ran at 13:36. the delta record had an empty groups array (timing race). we've seen this once in staging but not in prod. immediate mitigation: re-run SCIM full sync for that user or add the project role back via support admin endpoints.
raj: steps for support to rebind roles without customer intervention:
```
# fetch user id
GET /admin/users?email=jamie@acme.com  Authorization: Bearer <support-token>
# resync SCIM for user
POST /admin/users/{user_id}/resync-scim  Authorization: Bearer <support-token>
# fallback: add role directly
POST /admin/roles  Authorization: Bearer <support-token>
{ "user_id": "{user_id}", "role": "project.viewer", "resource": "project:alpha" }
```
lydia: running resync now...
okta-bot: SCIM resync job queued for user_id U_9012 (eta ~15s)
lydia: resync completed and role bindings show project.viewer on alpha again. can you retry, @acme-admin?
acme-admin: opening now... got in! no more 403, can access project settings. thanks :white_check_mark: really appreciate the fast help.
sasha: marking P0->resolved on ticket and adding follow-up action: patch SCIM delta to ignore temporary empty-group deltas for 5m after session rotation, add telemetry alert for large group-drop events.
mia: filing infra bug (INF-1283) and will draft postmortem blameless timeline.
raj: follow-up tasks for engineering: patch delta processor + add metrics, add end-to-end test for IdP session rotation + SCIM timing.
lydia: leaving note on support ticket with commands we ran and resolution steps. closing thread.
acme-admin: thanks everyone, saved our deploy window! :pray:
